messages:
ida: Idea — quick 30m "Launchpad" webinar focusing on tactical inference wins. 3 x 7-min micro-demos + 10-min live Q&A. Aim: give product teams plug-and-play takeaways (latency wins, cost levers, embedding UX). Need: speaker names + 1-sentence abstracts by EOD Friday so marketing can draft reg page.
sam: Sounds great. Working title suggestion: 'Launchpad: Practical Inference Playbooks for Product Teams'. Also recommend reg form capture: use_case (benchmarks/embeddings/private) and team_size.
marco: I can do the customer demo (FinTech). Will ask Maya about a short recorded clip in case live model hiccups. Wed rehearsal 9am PT preferable for me.
ava: Ops checklist: fallback video + cached demo responses ready. For demo 1 (benchmarks) we should test both streaming and full-response modes; streaming looks sexier but harder to record.
ops-bot: calendar: "Launchpad: tech check & rehearsal" created for Wed 2024-05-15 09:00 PT 1 link: https://calendar.internal/evt/4721
ida: Draft abstracts (seed):
- Demo 1 (benchmarks): "Reduce per-token costs by 3x with adaptive batching and prefix cache while keeping p99 stable"
- Demo 2 (quant/quality): "Quantization in production: when to apply it and how to detect subtle regressions"
- Demo 3 (customer): "Embedding-first search: how a customer hit 50ms first-answer using routing + small-model fallbacks"
Please expand to 1-2 sentences and send back.
sam: Lead routing: add hidden tags on reg form: interest=benchmarks|embeddings|private. Route interest=benchmarks -> SDR Queue A, others -> Queue B. Add UTM utm=launchpad_playbook.
marco: Proposed compact run-of-show: 
00:00 Host intro (ida)
02:30 Demo 1 - Benchmarks (sam)
09:30 Demo 2 - Quant & Quality (sam)
16:30 Demo 3 - Customer (marco + Maya)
23:30 Live Q&A (panel)
30:00 Close + CTA (trial link / request demo)
ida: Need a 3-line pivot script if a demo fails + a 90s recorded clip we can play. Also prepare 5 edge-case prompts per demo for rehearsal.
ava: Rehearsal plan: tech-check 30m (streaming, mics, separate audio tracks, recording capture, fallback playback), full run 45m (timings, transitions). I'll upload a 5-item test vector CSV and fallback clips by Thu EOD.
maya: Happy to be the customer speaker. I'll provide a 1-paragraph case blurb and a 30s recorded clip by Thu. Also confirm availability for rehearsal Wed 9am PT.
sam: I'll draft reg copy + 2 subject lines to A/B test (short vs descriptive). Also set conversion events: webinar_registered, demo_clicked, lead_sdr_queue.
ida: We should also include a CTA segmentation in the post-webinar email: trial link for self-serve + 'request enterprise demo' for larger teams.
ops-bot: reminder: rehearsal tech-check scheduled 48h before live.
marco: I'll DM PR to get approval for customer clip usage and a short quote.
ida: Great. Last ask: marketing ops please ensure registrant segmentation is exported daily to SDR with interest tags. :thumbsup:
